turns.prompt: Move Friday strength to Wednesday 8:29 PM, keeping its 40 minutes and soccer unchanged.
turns.text:
Friday strength cannot start at **8:29 PM** because Wednesday soccer runs until **8:30 PM**. Exact back-to-back timing is allowed, so **8:30–9:10 PM** would work and leaves soccer unchanged.

Would you like me to stage that move for **Wednesday 8:30 PM**?
